facts.fact: Aiden 故意把钥匙留在门内，让 Mia 打不开门，因为惊喜还没布置完。
facts.anchor: I didn’t want you seeing anything until I’d finished.

facts.fact: Aiden 让 Mia 闭眼，牵她走过走廊，在客厅门口停下并遮住她的眼睛。
facts.anchor: He led her the few steps down her hallway and paused

facts.fact: Aiden 把客厅改造成两人第一次正式约会的室内版：树枝、光点、魔法罐、烤箱里的香肠。
facts.anchor: The sofa had been pushed back, making way for huge pots that held tree branches

facts.fact: Aiden 单膝跪地求婚，取出与 Mia 送他的戒指配套的祖母绿与钻石戒指。
facts.anchor: So, Princess, will you wear my ring?

facts.fact: 两天后早晨两人到店，向 Katie 与 Ophelia 公布婚讯。
facts.anchor: Two mornings later Aiden hesitated at the door to Glimmers and Sparkles.

facts.fact: Katie 误以为 Mia 因怀孕才答应，Mia 否认并说自己先求婚；Katie 又质疑只交往三个月，实际是八个月。
facts.anchor: Kitikat, I’m not pregnant. I asked him because I love him.

facts.fact: 撞窗巨响后 Aiden 出门，发现 Mist 正拨弄一团不动的白羽鸟。
facts.anchor: He headed outside and winced when he found Mist gently batting a mangled heap

facts.fact: 被救下的鸟开口说话，自报名字 Lunar 并道谢。
facts.anchor: Lunar. Thank you for helping me.
